conditions_1_to_6_verbatim_phase8_part_8: Fit unconstrained d x d ridge generators R_12, R_23 at the answer position per layer. Never parameterise into any known representation — unchanged standing rule. Note d_model ~ 5-8k on this model: fits are ~25-67M parameters per generator; use the activation-weighted formulations throughout and report conditioning.

Conditions 1-6 exactly as specified in the programme record, including: transfer (condition 1) on the disjoint vocabulary; cross-path (condition 2) fit-on-P / eval-on-G; activation-weighted group laws + braid (condition 3); nontriviality with the corrected difference-subspace support test, direction lt (condition 4); causal transport by patch-and-continue at or before first-decodable layer (condition 5) — note this requires a second GPU session with the model loaded, price it in; content preservation with episode-local probes (condition 6).

Add the 8B spectrum diagnostic to the battery: if H_role fires, report the invariant-subspace dimension — the verdict then states which representation family was found, closing the old limitation with a measurement.

Thresholds: recalibrate on a calibration split of this model's activations against shuffled-pair nulls (the Stage 1 thresholds were calibrated at d=64 and do not port). Freeze to committed config before the test split is touched. Single evaluation. Multiple-comparison correction across layers stated in advance.

conditional_8c_plan.selection_rules: lambda_rule and layer_rule frozen as in 8C: lambda = argmin over grid of min-over-layers cal transfer err (frozen calibrate_system rule); verdict layer = min(argmin cal transfer err at lambda*, first_decodable(P/fit cal)); single evaluation on the test split; no layer/lambda/threshold selection after test results are seen; fpr_target 0.05; descriptive per-layer reporting table Bonferroni-corrected at 0.05/|reporting set|, stated in advance
conditional_8c_plan.splits: 8C rule verbatim (phase8c_splits.py): universe = 300 disc bases per cell filtered to strict-orbit-correct under this model's preds_disc_*.json; deterministic split rng=default_rng((20260807, path=='G', vocab=='transfer', 8)) permutation; cal = first floor(n/2), test = next floor(n/2), odd remainder dropped (declared) for matched cal/test counts; test half read by no calibration/threshold code

verdict_space_verbatim_phase8_part_8C.H_retrieval: H_retrieval (condition 1 or 2 fails cleanly): the model solves composed role-binding by chained associative retrieval with no shared role operator — the big claim, answered in the negative, on the real object, with a validated instrument. This is the most likely outcome (prior ~0.7-0.8) and it is a *complete answer*, not a failure.
verdict_space_verbatim_phase8_part_8C.H_role: H_role (all conditions, both mandatory transfers): the model carries a cross-task role representation of S_3 — the big claim, positive, with the representation family identified by the spectrum diagnostic.
verdict_space_verbatim_phase8_part_8C.Inconclusive: Inconclusive (probe unavailability, conditioning failure): reported as such with the blocking condition named.
